Index.title: AgroVoiceAI
Index.desc: Meet AgroVoiceAI: Your virtual agronomy expert, revolutionizing farming with AI-driven insights and personalized guidance, ensuring every crop conversation yields success.

home.topic: Everything you need in a chatbot

crop.title: Crop Recommendations
crop.desc: Receive personalized crop recommendations tailored to your soil type, climate, and available resources, maximizing your yield potential.

pest.title: Pest Identification
pest.desc: Spot crop pests and diseases in user-uploaded images, get quick solutions.

weather.title: Weather Forecasting
weather.desc: Get precise weather updates for your location, perfect for planning your farm activities.

tips.title: Crop Management Tips
tips.desc: Get timely tips and best practices for crop cultivation, covering planting, fertilization, pruning, and harvesting.

market.title: Market Prices and Trends
market.desc: Get market prices and trends for agricultural commodities, aiding your sales decisions.

farming.title: Farming Q&A
farming.desc: Ask farming questions, get accurate answers instantly.

soil.title: Soil Health Assessment
soil.desc: Assess soil health, including soil testing recommendations and interpretation of soil test results, to optimize crop yield and sustainability.

hero.desc: AgroVoiceAI is a farming assistant you can talk to in Tamil or English: crop advice, your district's weather, today's market prices, soil readings and pest checks.
hero.denied: Microphone blocked. Move across the field to make wind instead.
hero.stage: A lit plot of paddy on red Tamil Nadu soil with a soil probe in it. The plants sway with your voice.

tools.title: Five tools, one assistant
tools.empty: No tool by that name. Try chat, weather, market, soil or pest.

chat.name: Ask the assistant
chat.desc: Type or speak a question in Tamil or English. Answers take your district and crops into account.

weather.name: Weather for your district
weather.desc: The forecast for where you farm, with rain and wind, for planning field work.

market.name: Today's market prices
market.desc: Wholesale and retail prices for vegetables and fruits, so you know what a load is worth before you leave.

soil.name: Read your soil
soil.desc: Readings from the soil probe, explained, with fertiliser advice in plain words.

pest.name: Identify a pest
pest.desc: Photograph a damaged leaf. The assistant names the pest or disease and what to do about it.

settings.name: Set your district and crops
settings.desc: Tell it where you farm and what you grow once. Every answer uses it.

preview.label: Example conversation
preview.q: நாற்று நட்டு 20 நாள் ஆச்சு. யூரியா எவ்வளவு போடணும்?
preview.qt: Seedlings were planted 20 days ago. How much urea should I add?
preview.a: For paddy at tillering, apply about 30 kg of urea per acre. Drain the field to a thin film of water first, and spread it in the evening.
